description: Tacoma News Tribune has once again endorsed Republican Drew Stokesbary with "no reservations" for election to the State House, concluding that "There’s little question Stokesbary’s presence representing the 31st will be a benefit to the region and the state."
paid_for_by: Paid for by Friends of Drew Stokesbary (R)
title: TNT: Who can best represent voters in WA’s 31st Legislative District? The choice is clear (2022) - Re-Elect Drew Stokesbary
